_comment: Two accepted shapes. The object form is the one the DEF-120 card produces:
a `Name <email>` roster plus ONE consent answer for the wave. Prefer it.
The bare-array form is still accepted for per-row consent.
consent.answer:   'all'      -> every row is emailable unless it sets consent:false
'partial'  -> grants nothing by itself; mark the agreed rows
consent.recorded_at: the date the answer was given (YYYY-MM-DD).
consent.source:      where that answer came from, e.g. 'issue-card:cb560df2'.
All three are required for a wave-level answer to count, exactly as they are
per row. Omit any one and the wave consent is ignored — the gate is default-deny.
Per row, only email and name are needed. username is derived from the address
and reported in the dry run. password is machine-generated at send time and
the recipient replaces it via the login page's forgot-password link. Supply
either if you want to pin it, but do not put real credentials in a file you

roster.name: Marked Individually
